summary.headline: The Conservation Commission reviewed several Notices of Intent, certificates of compliance, and enforcement orders, including discussions on pool installations and stormwater management.
summary.summary: The Conservation Commission met on October 8, 2026, to discuss multiple property applications. Key items included a Notice of Intent for a pool in the buffer zone at 1 Overlook Drive, stormwater management permits for athletic fields at 0 Marlborough Junction and apartment buildings at 0 Southville Road, certificates of compliance for properties on Pine Hill Road and Southville Road, and an enforcement order review at 6 Limbrook Road. The commission also touched on the FY28 budget preview and ongoing flooding concerns at Madison Place on Route 9.

topics.title: 1 Overlook Drive - Notice of Intent for pool
topics.summary: The commission opened a continued public hearing for a Notice of Intent submitted by Ron Eppen for property at 1 Overlook Drive, regarding the construction of a pool and cabana within the buffer zone.
key_details: Address: 1 Overlook Drive
Applicant: Ron Eppen, represented by Caryn Ferguson of Goddard Consulting
Project: Construction of a pool, concrete patio, and cabana within the 100-foot buffer zone
Planting plan: Proposing eight native shrubs (Northern spicebush and sweet pepperbush)
Sediment control barrier added between work area and resource area
topics.outcome: Hearing continued to a later date.

topics.title: 0 Marlborough Junction - Notice of Intent / Stormwater Management Permit
topics.summary: The commission considered a request for continuance regarding a Notice of Intent and stormwater management permit for Map 91, Lot 6 at 0 Marlborough Junction for the relocation and reconstruction of athletic fields, including conversion of natural gas fields to artificial turf.
key_details: Address: 0 Marlborough Junction (Map 91, Lot 6)
Project: Relocation and reconstruction of athletic fields and conversion of natural gas fields to artificial turf
Applicant requested a continuance

topics.title: 27 Pine Hill Road - Certificate of Compliance
topics.summary: The commission reviewed a request for a Certificate of Compliance for an in-ground pool installed in the rear yard within the riverfront area at 27 Pine Hill Road.
key_details: Address: 27 Pine Hill Road
Project: In-ground pool installation in rear yard with split-rail fence and native shrub plantings
Site inspected; no erosion observed, work completed and stable

topics.title: 21 Southville Road - Certificate of Compliance
topics.summary: The commission reviewed a request for a Certificate of Compliance for a porch-to-sunroom conversion and patio addition at 21 Southville Road.
key_details: Address: 21 Southville Road
Project: Conversion of porch to sunroom and addition of patio in the buffer zone
Site inspected; work completed, stable, and existing fence acts as a natural buffer

topics.title: 6 Limbrook Road - Enforcement Order Review
topics.summary: The commission reviewed an old enforcement order from 2013 regarding unpermitted masonry/retaining wall construction and mowing extending to the water at 6 Limbrook Road.
key_details: Address: 6 Limbrook Road
Enforcement order date: 2013
Issue: Retaining wall/brick wall built near the water along the property line without active closure
Mowing and clearing had occurred within the DCR property; MWRA now mows that section
topics.outcome: Voted to lift the 2013 enforcement order since work is completed and no active erosion exists.
topics.why_it_matters: Resolves long-standing property compliance issues involving buffer zones and resource protection areas.

topics.title: FY28 Budget Review and Madison Place Flooding Update
topics.summary: The conservation agent provided a preview of the FY28 budget (carried over from the previous meeting) and discussed ongoing flooding concerns on Route 9 near Madison Place due to beaver dams.
key_details: FY28 budget draft to be finalized and sent to the commission
Madison Place flooding on Route 9 (behind Madison Place): caused by beaver dams on the property
MassDOT and management company contacted regarding beaver dam removal and public safety
topics.outcome: No formal vote; informational updates only.

topics.title: 0 Southville Road - Stormwater Management Application
topics.summary: The commission discussed a notice of intent and stormwater management application for the construction of two apartment buildings and associated site work at 0 Southville Road.
key_details: Address: 0 Southville Road
Project: Construction of two apartment buildings and site work
Applicant requested a continuance as Lucas Environmental finishes its peer review
topics.outcome: Voted to continue the hearing to the next meeting.
topics.why_it_matters: Affects multi-family housing development and stormwater management in town.

votes.motion: Motion to approve minutes from the last meeting
Motion to continue public hearing for 1 Overlook Drive
Motion to continue notice of intent for 0 Marlborough Junction
Motion to issue Certificate of Compliance for 27 Pine Hill Road
Motion to issue Certificate of Compliance for 21 Southville Road
Motion to lift the enforcement order for 6 Limbrook Road
Motion to close public hearing and issue order of conditions for 1 Overlook Drive
Motion to continue notice of intent for 0 Southville Road

upcoming.what: Next Conservation Commission meeting (continuances for 1 Overlook Drive, 0 Marlborough Junction, and 0 Southville Road)
